cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put the broken vase in your apology's subject line. I taught you how to write Mum a proper letter; make this one specific.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A complete word. Progress. Sorry for what? She could think you're apologising for the font.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send 'Sorry about the vase'. She still thinks you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'I broke the vase'. We practised putting the person before the action; don't lose the 'I' now it's you. Then tell her you're sorry.
